# Temple Scroll Column 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 29 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**29:1** And you shall consecrate them, and they shall be holy; and you shall sanctify the altar, and it shall be most holy.

**29:2** And you shall consecrate the laver and its base, and you shall sanctify them; and they shall be most holy.

**29:3** And you shall consecrate the entire inner court: the altar and the house and the laver and the colonnade and all the vessels of the service; and they shall be most holy forever.

**29:4** And you shall consecrate the middle court, with its colonnades and its rooms and its gates; and it shall be holy.

**29:5** And you shall consecrate them, and they shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation before Me, as I spoke to Moses on the day that I brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

**29:6** And the holy of holies, and the holy place, and the place of the altar, and the courts: these are the dwelling of My name.

**29:7** For in it I will settle My glory until the day of blessing, when I Myself shall create My temple and establish it for Myself for all days.

**29:8** According to the covenant which I made with Jacob at Bethel, and the promise which I promised to Abraham and to Isaac and to Jacob.

**29:9** And I will set the land as holy, as the Garden of Eden; and the earth before it — as the sun and the moon; for I will dwell in the midst of it.

**29:10** And My glory shall rest upon it, and I will not cast them away from before My face; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.

**29:11** And they shall be My people, and I shall be their God; and the king of My people shall be before Me all the days.

**29:12** And a kingdom of priesthood — a holy nation — they shall be before Me in the midst of the land which I give to them.

**29:13** And the land shall be holy, from the wilderness of Egypt to the wilderness, and from the bank of the great sea to the Euphrates.

**29:14** The land and all that is in it shall be holy to Me, and all its fruits and all its produce; the tithes and the firstfruits shall be for the house of My sanctuary.

**29:15** And the whole earth shall know that I am the God of Israel, and the father of all the children of Jacob.

**29:16** And I shall rule over them forever, from this generation to the generation of the age, for I am the LORD their God.

---

*EMET notes: Column 29 well preserved. This is the theological climax of the temple section, transitioning from architectural instructions to eschatological vision. v.7 contains the crucial promise of a divinely created temple. "Day of blessing" (yom haberakhah) is unique to the Temple Scroll. The Jacob/Bethel covenant (v.8) and Garden of Eden imagery (v.9) frame the temple within cosmic theology.*
